claim: TikTok Indonesia explicitly confirmed in verbatim testimony to DPR Komisi I that the 8-million/63%-above-UMR figure describes creators on the TikTok platform specifically, not Indonesian content creators generally.
stance_target: platform-specific (not national) scope of the 8-juta/63-persen figure
scope_conditions: Indonesia, TikTok platform only, 15 July 2025 DPR Komisi I RDPU hearing
quoted_support: "Sekitar 8 juta kreator di platform TikTok sudah meraup penghasilan melalui fitur monetisasi... Dari 8 juta kreator, 63 persen juga sudah mendapatkan penghasilan lebih dari UMR."

claim: When directly asked by DPR Komisi I member Nico Siahaan to disclose TikTok Indonesia's actual revenue, TikTok's public policy representative declined, citing a need to consolidate figures across e-commerce and video-distribution business lines -- illustrating selective disclosure (favorable creator-monetization stats shared, revenue withheld).
stance_target: transparency of TikTok's disclosures to Indonesian regulators
scope_conditions: Indonesia, DPR Komisi I hearing, 15 July 2025
quoted_support: "Data penghasilan memang saya belum pegang, karena ada banyak juga dari sisi e-commerce, dari sisi video distribusi platform-nya juga, sehingga hal tersebut perlu kami konsolidasikan terlebih dahulu."

claim: TikTok reported approximately 125 million monthly active users in Indonesia and 21 million sellers across TikTok Shop and Tokopedia as of the July 2025 DPR hearing.
stance_target: scale of TikTok's user and seller base in Indonesia
quoted_support: "kini tercatat ada sekitar 125 juta pengguna aktif TikTok... ada sekitar 21 juta penjual atau seller di platform e-commerce mereka, TikTok Shop dan Tokopedia"
